description: Lists every OPEN decision on the call's Decision Board, from all agents in the call and their helper sessions (relay, MCP, bridge), oldest number first. Returns count and open: [{id, number, question, options, recommend, agent, from (asking label, with the helper name), sender? (helper session), state, at (created, epoch), age_s, mine (asked by this session or one of its helpers), context? (background for Delta)}]. Decided ones are not listed. Errors: 503 = voicebot not (yet) in the call.
name: decisions
title: List open decisions
